description.en: The region ID of the resource.
The resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs.

description.zh: 资源类型。目前仅支持cluster，即E-HPC集群。
description.en: The resource type. Set the value to cluster, which indicates E-HPC clusters.
The resource tags. You can specify up to 20 tags.

description.zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag key. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`.

description.zh: 标签值。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag value. The tag value cannot be an empty string. It can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`.

title.zh: 为指定资源创建并绑定标签

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type cluster --resource-id ehpc-hz-xxxx --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpc TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'ehpc-hz-xxxx' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ResourceType cluster --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
